threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground' when you're on the East London line, and you look utterly lost at Dalston Junction.
The number 37 bus was filled with a bizarre mix of rowdy teens and a woman in a glittery gown, debating whether goldfish could be psychic. Only in Clapham.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a street musician playing a traditional Kurdish song, as kids rode their bikes past, I knew Neukölln was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you grab a Kebab at 3 AM, then stumble into a 24-hour Späti for a fresh Berliner Weiße to wash it down. Pure magic.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows there's no ‘quick’ way out of Dolores Park on Sundays—just a lot of frustrated BART riders waiting for delays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus on Van Ness where the driver calmly resolved a fare dispute while navigating a beeping detour. Classic San Francisco chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is just about the parks and plazas, but it’s the little side streets where you find the real charm and best tapas.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their fumbling attempts to order at cafés—'un café amb llet' becomes a tongue-twister instead of just a simple request.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know someone’s new when they still look at the bus timetable instead of just trusting that it’ll show up eventually. Classic rookie move.
Last night on the N37, a group of lads dropped a saxophone solo mid-journey. It turned the usual chaos into a makeshift gig—Brixton nights at their best.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the guy selling homemade empanadas out of a shopping cart while pigeons argued over a discarded doner in front of the canal.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you'll find spontaneous street parties with DJs and barbecues popping up under the S-Bahn tracks. Feels like summer magic every time!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: They know to always carry a jacket, even in August. Those who don’t? They're just here for the tech jobs and sunshine.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus at the corner of Larkin and Eddy, and a saxophonist hopped on mid-song, turning the ride into a free concert. Classic SF!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think all the good tapas are in fancy bars, but the best ones are tucked away in tiny shops with just a counter and a smiling abuela.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newbie by their struggle with the T-10 card machine—just watch them wrestle with it at the metro station.
